_description: Reverse-engineered from Figma TRATON branch BRANCH:checkbox-radio-toggle-13 (cluster 13, CDEP-1967). Mirrors Checkbox structure minus the indeterminate variant axis — radio is always single-select. Per-row aliases use single 4-mode semantics; brand/mode swap is handled by the semantic layer.
_notes: Variant-axis-preservation rule applied: border + background split per variant (standard/selected) even where values are identical. Icon follows canvas evidence (no glyph on standard — the dot only appears on selected). Text label sits off the varying surface — no variant axis.
Indicator has no variant axis by design: the hover overlay ring is visually identical across both radio variants. Single border/indicator-default + border/indicator-hover pair covers both.
Indicator hover uses color/border/discrete (Radio-specific); Checkbox uses color/border/subtle. Locked as-is per canvas evidence; flagged for designer review to confirm intentional divergence.

Background-selected tokens use brand-primitive direct aliases (blue/950 + base/white TRATON; grey/950 + grey/50 Scania) — endpoints copied from color/icon/strong's resolution chain per Tegel UI Library source-of-truth. Resolves the prior icon-to-background property-match smell at the component-token level. A foundation-level color/background/inverse/strong semantic would let this collapse back to a single alias if added later.
Focus-ring radius uses component/-focus/ring/radius/full because radio is round. Checkbox uses medium for its square box.

Disabled state via wrapper-only opacity-disabled pattern (LOCKED, see convention-opacity-disabled-wrapper.md): Radio Button/Input root owns opacity for standalone use; Radio Button/Item root owns opacity AND forces nested Input instance to Disabled=False so opacities don't compound; Label Text inherits dim multiplicatively from Item root. No *-disabled color tokens; no Label-level opacity binding.
Focus state via component/-focus/* helper. No component-level border/focus token.

Component topology (LOCKED, see convention-component-topology.md): Radio Button/Input (Source, 30173:78572) + Radio Button/Item (Wrapper, 30173:78607) + Radio Button Group (Layout wrapper, 30296:78668). Bindings live on Source; Wrapper owns Label Text + parent opacity; Group inherits.

Axis-name divergence (designer handover candidate): Radio Button/Item uses Selected=True/False; Radio Button/Input uses Selected=Yes/No (same axis name, different value labels). Different stripe of divergence than Checkbox's (which had Selected vs Checked). Flag for normalization.

variables.name: component/radio-button/border/standard-hover
variables.comment: Hover state — outer border unchanged; visual hover comes from indicator overlay.

variables.name: component/radio-button/border/selected-default
variables.comment: Selected variant has no outer border (fill-only).

variables.name: component/radio-button/border/indicator-default
variables.comment: Hover-overlay ring at rest (transparent). Single token applied across both radio variants — no variant axis on indicator.

variables.name: component/radio-button/border/indicator-hover
variables.comment: Hover-overlay ring on hover. Checkbox uses color/border/subtle here — divergence locked, flagged for designer handover.

variables.name: component/radio-button/background/selected-default
variables.comment: Filled circle when selected. 4-mode brand-primitive direct, endpoints copied from color/icon/strong's resolution chain per Tegel UI source: TRATON Light blue/950 / Dark base/white; Scania Light grey/950 / Dark grey/50. Resolved the prior icon-to-background alias smell at the component level.

variables.name: component/radio-button/icon/selected-default
variables.comment: Inner dot on filled circle. Cross-swap of background-selected — semantic resolves white on dark fill (Light) and dark on white fill (Dark).

variables.name: component/radio-button/text/default
variables.comment: Label sits adjacent to the circle — off the varying surface. No variant axis by design.

variables.name: component/radio-button/border/radius-default
variables.comment: Corner radius for full-round shape. 4-mode per brand-primitive-aliases convention (LOCKED). NOTE: no canvas binding currently — the Field layer is an ELLIPSE (geometrically round, cornerRadius doesn't apply). Token exists in the spec for symmetry with checkbox + future-proofing if Field is ever restructured to a RECTANGLE with cornerRadius.

variables.name: component/radio-button/focus-ring/radius-default
variables.comment: Refs shared -focus utility group. Full radius because radio is round.

variables.name: component/radio-button/opacity/disabled
variables.comment: 25% opacity for disabled state. 4-mode per brand-primitive-aliases convention (LOCKED) — each brand has independent primitives.
